items.quote: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea
items.claim: The text says Moses stretched out his hand over the sea.

items.quote: the LORD caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land
items.claim: The text says the LORD made the sea go back using a strong east wind that blew all night, which turned the sea into dry land.
items.action: caused to go back; made dry land
items.mechanism: a strong east wind blowing all that night

items.claim: The text says the waters were divided.
